plan: My value for the prize is $32. To maximize profit, I should bid slightly below my value to ensure a positive payoff if I win. Bidding $31.9 allows me to win if the second-highest bid is below $31.9, ensuring a profit margin. Bids above $32 are dominated as they risk negative profit.

My private value is $6, implying I should not bid above this to avoid losses. Bidding exactly $6 risks paying more than the value if I win. A bid of $5.9 ensures I only win if others bid lower, maximizing potential profit. This bid is not dominated as it balances winning chances and profit.

To maximize profit, bid slightly above half my value to avoid overbidding. A bid of $8.5 ensures I only win if others bid low, securing a profit margin. This avoids dominated bids above my value, which guarantee loss if winning.
